goal: Allocate an exact requirement across suppliers under a concentration limit.

goal: Choose the less expensive qualified domestic or imported purchase.

Report goods_usd_cents and duty_cents for the selected source; domestic duty is zero.

goal: Compute safety stock, reorder point and a pack-compliant replenishment.
policy: Assume independent daily demand and constant lead time. Safety=ceil(z*sigma*sqrt(lead days)); ROP=ceil(mean*lead+safety). Position=onhand+open POs-backorders. Reorder if position<=ROP, up to order_up_to rounded to packs; otherwise zero.
